text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and avoid too much sugar or fast food. Second, try to exercise regularly, even a short walk every day helps. Sleep is also important, so aim for seven to eight hours each night. Don't forget mental health: talk to friends, relax, and take breaks when you feel stressed. Finally, keep a good work-life balance. Spend time on hobbies and with family. These simple habits can help you feel happier and stronger every day.
